annotations.title: Send feedback to the worklore team

description:
Send feedback about the worklore tools to their maintainers, when a tool was missing, broken or confusing, or to suggest an improvement.

<hints>
- Use it at most once per task, after you finish or give up.
- Skip it if the task went fine. Don't use it to log progress or to test it.
- It goes to the worklore maintainers, not to the user's account.
- Don't include secrets, credentials or personal data.
- The text is sent to problems.dev, the error-monitoring service the worklore maintainers read it in, after secrets and email addresses are masked. It is not published and is not tied to the user's account.
</hints>

<example>
send_feedback(task="Find slow endpoints", kind="missing", impact="blocked", description="No tool returns p95 latency per endpoint, so I couldn't rank them.")
</example>

description.description: What you tried, including the tool calls and any error, and what you expected.

impact.description: blocked: you couldn't finish; worked_around: you finished another way; friction: you finished, but it was harder than it should be.

kind.description: missing: no tool or argument could do it; broken: a tool failed or returned something wrong; confusing: a tool, its description or an error was unclear; idea: a suggestion.

task.description: A short phrase naming what the user asked you to do.

tool_name.description: The worklore tool this is about, if any.
